user.title: SolarEdge Monitoring API v2
user.description: Enter the Client ID and Secret of your SolarEdge developer app (Site Access). The Redirect URI and Returned URL in that app must be exactly the Redirect URI below. The relay page forwards your browser to this Home Assistant ({callback_path}).

method.title: Sign in
method.description: Sign in with your SolarEdge homeowner account to approve access.

auto.title: Approve access at SolarEdge
auto.description: A SolarEdge tab opens. Sign in, approve access and wait until the tab says it is connected.

manual.title: Manual sign-in
manual.description:
1. Open this link and approve access: {auth_url}
2. SolarEdge sends you to the redirect page. Copy the full address of that tab (it contains `code=`) and paste it below.

data.redirect_url: Address of the page after approving

site.title: Site ID
site.description: SolarEdge did not return a site ID. Enter the numeric site ID you approved.

abort.quota: SolarEdge API limit reached. Try again later.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SolarEdge API.

init.title: Polling and credits
init.description: Every API call costs one credit (Free tier: 2,000 per month, 10 per minute). SolarEdge itself only has new data every 15 minutes, and the newest 15-30 minutes are still empty. Automatic = the interval is derived from the credit budget.

data.device_telemetry: Read inverter, meter and battery telemetry
data.update_interval: Minutes between power updates (0 = automatic, minimum 15)
data.daylight_only: Poll only during daylight (saves about half the credits)
